The Tire Guide is completely free to use. If you end up purchasing tires through the affiliate links in the guide (we partner with TireRack, SimpleTire, and Amazon), you’re directly supporting the time and work that goes into building and maintaining tools like this. Every click helps keep the lights on and the guide growing.
Have feedback? The Tire Guide is constantly evolving based on community input. If you spot a tire that should be added, find a bug, or have an idea for a feature, reach out anytime at [email protected]. You can also follow the development process on the Tire Guide GitHub page where updates and improvements are shared in real time.
